summary: Tested the Liquidaciones 'Pago al propietario' feature end-to-end. Backend: 12 of 13 pytest tests pass (the 7 existing ones plus 6 new ones). The new ones check the real PDF text for both states (pending and paid), the default date being today, 400 for monto 0 or negative, 404 for an unknown reservation, uploading a receipt and downloading it back byte-for-byte, notes with & and < characters, and a mark-paid then revert round trip on the A161 fixture. The only failure: an invalid 'metodo' (e.g. 'bitcoin') is accepted with 200. UI (qa_varela): the list badges, the form prefilled with today and the neto, the green confirmation card with fecha/método/monto/notas plus Ver comprobante (opens the file) and Deshacer, the Liquidada badge in the list, re-marking, the adjust-movements regression (neto goes 180.000 -> 179.889 -> 180.000) and Descargar PDF all work. One small UX bug: after Deshacer the form keeps the old values and the old file.

minor.issue: 'metodo' is not checked against transferencia|efectivo|cheque|otro, so any string is saved (e.g. 'bitcoin' returns 200). The PDF then prints the raw value.
The default fecha uses date.today() in the server timezone (UTC). For Argentina (UTC-3) a payment recorded after 21:00 local time with no fecha gets tomorrow's date.
Revert ($unset) and re-marking leave the uploaded receipt in Supabase storage with nothing pointing to it. Not urgent.

ui_bugs.issue: After revert the form keeps the previous monto/metodo/notas (4321/efectivo/'TEST_UI pago') instead of going back to the neto and transferencia. pagoFile is also not cleared, so clicking 'Marcar como pagada' again without choosing a file silently re-uploads the old receipt (confirmed: Ver comprobante showed after re-marking with no new file). Cause: the reset useEffect depends only on liq.reserva.id. Fix: reset pagoForm and pagoFile inside revertirPago.

issues: HOY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) is the UTC date and is computed once when the module loads. After 21:00 in Argentina the date field prefills with tomorrow, and it goes stale if the tab stays open past midnight.
revertirPago has no try/catch and no loading state (marcarPago does).

action_items: Check metodo in marcar-pagada against {transferencia, efectivo, cheque, otro} and return 400 otherwise
In revertirPago, reset pagoForm to {fecha: today, metodo: 'transferencia', monto: neto, notas: ''} and call setPagoFile(null)
Use the local date (or America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires) for the default fecha in both the frontend HOY and the backend date.today()
critical_code_review_comments: The metodo Form field is not validated (no Literal/enum)
The pagoFile state survives a revert, so a stale file gets re-uploaded
revertirPago in the frontend has no error handling

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows pass; one low-priority form-reset bug)
